Package Services

Class MapService

java.lang.Object
Services.MapService
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class MapService extends Object implements Serializable
The MapService class provides services related to maps. This class can be used to perform various CRUD operations and show maps with continents, country and it's neighbours

    • loadMap

      public Map loadMap(GameState p_gameState, String p_loadFileName) throws InvalidMap
      Loads a map from a specified file, parsing continent, country, and border data to create a complete map structure.
      Parameters:
      p_gameState - The game state into which the loaded map will be set.
      p_loadFileName - The name of the file from which to load the map.
      Returns:
      The loaded and fully constructed Map object.
      Throws:
      InvalidMap - If any errors occur during the file reading process or if the data is not correctly formatted.

    • loadFile

      public List<String> loadFile(String p_loadFileName) throws InvalidMap
      Loads the contents of a specified map file into a list of strings.
      Parameters:
      p_loadFileName - The name of the file to be loaded.
      Returns:
      A list of strings, each containing the contents of one line from the file.
      Throws:
      InvalidMap - If the file cannot be found, is inaccessible, or any other IOException occurs.

    • editMap

      public void editMap(GameState p_gameState, String p_editFilePath) throws IOException, InvalidMap
      Prepares a map for editing by attempting to create a new map file if it does not exist or loading an existing map file for editing.
      Parameters:
      p_gameState - The current game state.
      p_editFilePath - The path to the file to be edited.
      Throws:
      IOException - If an I/O error occurs during the file operation.
      InvalidMap - If the existing map file is found to be invalid during the loading process.
